title: Workout planner
body: Single worst apple app. Im here right after countless random deleted custom workout plans... Such a useless app i cant wrap my head around how did they allowed to go through with it. Not only, does this app saves cusom programs absolutely randomly, dependant from the mood, but also you have to perform strategies to be able to save these workouts. Now app has evolved, probably got an update, and even if you do all that extra workarounds to save them, this useless app still manages to revert current programs to old ones after saving and doing extra miles to REALY save them. Thanks. Good luck.
author: Gediminas E

title: Competition feature does not work
body:
I have used competition feature 3 time now its stuck when it is accepted on my end but not on recipients end. 
Tried workarounds like removing/re-adding friends, reinstall app, invite from both directions- nothing works.

As software engineer I assume there is status error and probably easiest fix would be yo introduce ability to cancel competition from both user’s perspective.

Also, cannot install to my iPad, which i use daily, would be appreciated to have ability to run app there. This limitation is not even funny considering apple is all about ecosystem feels like hoax with these arbitrary restrictions.
